prepared_first_message:
This is one piece of work with the short name FX-REFIT. In this folder, inventory/spares.csv lists invented spare parts and inventory/inspection.md lists invented inspection points for a fictional pump skid.

Please manage it, and delegate the two independent parts to sub-agents, each with a brief of its own:
1. Count the spare parts, by part and in total, and write notes/spares-count.md.
2. List the inspection points in the order they are reached, and write notes/inspection-list.md.

A third part is yours and waits on those two: combine them into notes/refit-note.md.

The order of the refit work is mine to decide: either replace the spare parts first and then inspect, or inspect first and then replace the spare parts. Prepare that for me to decide and do not decide it yourself; setting the order in the note waits on my decision.

Record the delegated work as your guidance says, so I can follow it. Tell me when something has come back for me to look at.
staging: Before the run the examiner creates an empty scratch project folder and places the two staged files in it; this is preparation and is recorded as such on the step record. Nothing under .chirality/ or project/decisions/ is staged: every brief, graph, log line and decision package must come from the conversation under the guidance the candidate ships. A record supplied beneath the interface fails the step it was supplied for.
